mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'A'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", EMAIL AS "memberEmail", NICKNAME AS "memberNickname", NAME AS "memberName", PROFILE_IMAGE AS "memberProfileImg", MEMBER_TYPE AS "memberRole", STATUS AS "memberStatus", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt" FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE 1=1
AND NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND (NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_BOARD C
JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE C.STATUS != 'N'
AND (C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R
JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE R.STATUS != 'N'
AND (R.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION WHERE 1=1
AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR REGION LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT R.REPORT_NO AS "reportNo", R.TARGET_TYPE AS "targetType", R.TARGET_NO AS "targetNo", R.MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", R.REPORT_TYPE AS "reportType", R.DETAIL_REASON AS "detailReason", R.STATUS AS "status", R.RESULT AS "result", TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", TO_CHAR(R.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt", M.NICKNAME AS "reporterNickname", CASE R.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'FREEBOARD' THEN (SELECT B.BOARD_TITLE FROM BOARD B WHERE B.BOARD_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMPANION' THEN (SELECT CB.TITLE FROM COMPANION_BOARD CB WHERE CB.COMPANION_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN (SELECT CR.TITLE FROM COMPANION_REVIEW CR WHERE CR.REVIEW_NO = R.TARGET_NO) END AS "targetTitle", CASE R.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'FREEBOARD' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M2 ON B.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMPANION' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM COMPANION_BOARD CB JOIN MEMBER M2 ON CB.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE CB.COMPANION_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM COMPANION_REVIEW CR JOIN MEMBER M2 ON CR.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE CR.REVIEW_NO = R.TARGET_NO) END AS "targetAuthorNickname" FROM CONTENT_REPORT R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, RESULT = #{result}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'P'
